description.value:
You overwhelm a creature's mind with a cascade of contradictory impulses and shattered cognition. The target takes 4d6 mental damage and must attempt a Will save. On a failure, the target is also afflicted with the Fractures of Madness curse: it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 4}, cannot Cast Spells, and treats all non-hostile creatures as friendly (following the last spoken order given to it unless compliance would cause self-harm). The curse persists indefinitely but can be ended by the spell remove curse (rank 4 or higher), or a rank-9 healing or restoration spell. The target may attempt a new Will save to end the curse at each monthly interval.

Critical Success The target takes no mental damage and is unaffected by the curse.

Success The target takes half mental damage and is @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 2} for 1 minute (no curse).

Failure The target takes full mental damage and is afflicted with the Fractures of Madness curse (@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Stupefied]{Stupefied 4}, cannot Cast Spells, treats non-hostiles as friendly).

Critical Failure As failure, and the target immediately Strides toward the nearest visible creature and attacks it, regardless of allegiance (as the confusion condition for 1 round), before the longer-term curse takes hold.
